description: LibNC-free within-state arithmetic attribution for the exact ff1_19 gradient slice
hypothesis: Initializing eight adjacent output-feature lanes from the prior BF16 gradient and applying 32 sequential AVX2 FMAs before one BF16 state-boundary conversion reproduces the exact LibNC ff1_19 slice and its reverse/sign controls.

interfaces_exposed: open BF16 FF1 operands -> LibNC-free exact ff1_19 gradient slice

verdict: Freeze an immutable post-dot-add successor, require exact treatment plus reverse and sign controls under that cell, and only then expand the uniform open kernel beyond the 128-row slice.
